subjectOf.text: Redesigning legal doctrine around sharing and decentralized peer to peer platforms demands out of the box thinking from a profession whose members were trained, both in law school and across their careers, to think inside the box.

subjectOf.text: The regulatory challenges of blockchain based offerings should be addressed by revising federal securities law provisions to recognize digital securities, to permit broad based trading of equity-equivalent digital securities, and to permit their margining.
subjectOf.abstract: may be in part addressed by revising several federal securities law provisions to allow: (i) recognition of "digital securities," (ii) broad-based trading of equity-equivalent "digital securities," and (iii) margining of "digital securities."
